description: Fixed regression benchmark for REVIEW_PROCESS.md. Periods are integration-period indices (10 s each from the first pulse of the eclipse2024 recording; 10800 = 2024-04-08 16:00:00 UTC). Each was chosen because an earlier memo found something at it. Stages: lpi (outlier_lpi, pipeline defaults), fit_lpi, rd300 (avg_range_doppler_spec, mode 300) and fit_lp on the rd300 output. run_analysis.py itself is bypassed; its config mapping is not tested.
